headline: Camlin Fine Sciences Reports Higher Q2 Revenue but Margin Collapse
summary: Camlin Fine Sciences posted a 9% rise in revenue for the second quarter of fiscal 2027, accompanied by a sharp collapse in profit margins.
why: Camlin Fine Sciences is a specialty chemical manufacturer supplying shelf-life extension and performance materials, sensitive to input cost volatility.

impacts.name: Camlin Fine Sciences
impacts.why: While top-line revenue grew, collapsing margins signal severe pressures on operational profitability.
